item.title: ALDH3B2 Silencing Turns Duct Cells Into Insulin Makers
item.description: Harvard researchers silenced ALDH3B2, boosting pancreatic duct‑to‑beta conversion to 8.5% and restoring near‑normal glucose in diabetic mice for weeks.
